label: Python
description: Run a Python snippet. Declare the node's inputs and outputs inline: `ExecPython(x: Number) -> (result: String) { code: "..." }`. Inputs arrive as Python variables named after each port. A file input (Image, Audio, Video, Blob) arrives as its marker dict, and inside the snippet the marker carries a `url` the code can fetch (`inputs['photo']['__weft_image__']['url']`), minted for this firing. The Python code returns a dict keyed by output port name; a key set to None (or missing) emits no pulse on that port. Exceptions fail the node with the full traceback.
